title: Composition of normalized finite scalar pullback comparisons
statement: Let l be prime, let E,L,F be finite extensions of Q_l with Q_l-algebra maps iota:E to L and j:L to F, let f:X to Y be any scheme morphism, P any cochain complex of completed E-coefficient module sheaves on Y, and n a natural number. Use the normalized finite pullback levels and scalarPullbackLevel of [lem-pur-integral-scalar-finite-comparison-models] and the tensor-normalized ordinary scalar associator of [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition]. Extending the E-to-L level comparison along L to F, composing with the L-to-F level comparison, and then applying finite F-pullback to the scalar associator on Y equals the scalar associator on X followed by the direct E-to-F level comparison for j composed with iota. This is an equality of chain maps at the fixed finite reduction level n, before Roos completion.

source.place: Coefficient coherence for tensor reassociation and adjunction units; normalized finite pullback comparisons and the associated strict reduction towers (Stacks 03EL, 07A4, 08TC).

proof.text: Precompose the iterated comparison with the inverse scalar associator on X and postcompose with the pullback of the associator on Y to form a natural transformation having the same source and target as the direct E-to-F comparison. Evaluate on 1 tensor f-star(1 tensor x). The inverse associator inserts 1 tensor (1 tensor -), functoriality of scalar tensor sections and the two level normalizations give the corresponding double generator on Y, and pullback naturality transports its scalar associator. The associator multiplies the two units, yielding the direct normalized generator. Uniqueness of the normalized finite-level natural transformation identifies the maps. Evaluate at P and cancel the inverse associator. This uses no nonzero object, boundedness or invertibility of the comparison.

theorem integralScalarPullbackLevelComposition {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    (((integralOrdinaryScalar l L F j X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        ((scalarPullbackLevel l E L ι f n).app P)) ≫
      (scalarPullbackLevel l L F j f n).app
        (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
      (integralOperationsPullbackLevel l F f n).map
        ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (integralOrdinaryScalarComp l E L ι Y F j)
          (.up ℤ)).hom.app P) =
    (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (integralOrdinaryScalarComp l E L ι X F j)
      (.up ℤ)).hom.app ((integralOperationsPullbackLevel l E f n).obj P) ≫
        (scalarPullbackLevel l E F (j.comp ι) f n).app P
